name: WTI Crude Oil & Natural Gas: Macro Drivers & Q2 Seasonality
description: Research study analyzing key macro drivers for WTI crude oil (CL) and natural gas (NG) as of Q1 2026. Covers three themes: (1) Price trend with rolling 60-day annualized volatility for regime detection, (2) US production trends via FRED industrial production indices (crude oil and natural gas) with YoY changes, (3) Monthly seasonality patterns — average return by calendar month and year×month heatmaps — with focus on Q2 outlook. Includes cross-sectional summary table comparing key stats across both commodities.
source:
# =============================================================================
# WTI CRUDE OIL & NATURAL GAS: MACRO DRIVERS & Q2 SEASONALITY
# =============================================================================
# Theme 1: Price trend + rolling 60-day annualized volatility (regime detection)
# Theme 2: US production trends (FRED industrial production indices, YoY change)
# Theme 3: Monthly seasonality for both commodities — bars + heatmaps
# Cross-sectional: Key stats comparison table (vol, YTD return, avg Q2 return)
# =============================================================================

# --- Data: Futures Continuation ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
close = cont.c

# --- Daily Returns ---
daily_ret = returns(period=1)(close)

# --- Rolling 60-Day Annualized Volatility ---
vol_60d = volatility(period=60)(close)

# --- Date Components (daily timeframe) ---
idx = index()
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(idx)
year_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(idx)

# =============================================================================
# THEME 1: PRICE TREND + VOLATILITY REGIME
# =============================================================================
# xy_lines: Close price + 60-day vol on same time axis (per-asset)
xy_lines(
    title='Price Trend & 60-Day Volatility Regime',
    category='1. Price & Volatility',
    y_axis_label='Close Price / Volatility',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Close Price', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='60-Day Ann. Volatility', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=idx, y_values=(close, vol_60d))

# =============================================================================
# THEME 2: US PRODUCTION TRENDS (FRED)
# =============================================================================
# Industrial Production: Mining: Crude Oil (IPG21112S) — monthly, SA, Index 2017=100
oil_prod_date, oil_prod_val, oil_prod_rev = economic_indicators(series_id="IPG21112S", use_alfred=False)()
oil_prod_filled = ffill(oil_prod_val)

# Industrial Production: Mining: Natural Gas & NGLs (IPG21113S) — monthly, SA, Index 2017=100
ng_prod_date, ng_prod_val, ng_prod_rev = economic_indicators(series_id="IPG21113S", use_alfred=False)()
ng_prod_filled = ffill(ng_prod_val)

# YoY change: compare to value ~252 trading days ago (1 year of daily bars)
oil_prod_yoy = (oil_prod_filled - (oil_prod_filled >> 252)) / (oil_prod_filled >> 252)
ng_prod_yoy = (ng_prod_filled - (ng_prod_filled >> 252)) / (ng_prod_filled >> 252)

# Production level chart
xy_lines(
    title='US Production Index (Crude Oil & Natural Gas)',
    category='2. US Production Trends',
    y_axis_label='Index (2017=100)',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Crude Oil Production', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Natural Gas & NGL Production', color=Color.Teal)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=idx, y_values=(oil_prod_filled, ng_prod_filled))

# YoY change chart
xy_lines(
    title='US Production YoY Change',
    category='2. US Production Trends',
    y_axis_label='YoY Change',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='0%')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Crude Oil YoY', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Natural Gas YoY', color=Color.Teal)
    ]),
    order=3
)(x_values=idx, y_values=(oil_prod_yoy, ng_prod_yoy))

# =============================================================================
# THEME 3: MONTHLY SEASONALITY
# =============================================================================

# --- Monthly Returns (using month-end boundary detection) ---
month_end = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.month, boundary=BoundaryType.end)(idx)
prev_month_end_close = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(month_end, close)
monthly_ret = ((close - prev_month_end_close) / prev_month_end_close) if month_end else 0.0 / 0.0

# NaN-propagate the month label so only month-end bars have valid entries
nan_flag = monthly_ret / monthly_ret
month_label = month_num * nan_flag
year_label = year_num * nan_flag

# --- Chart: Average Monthly Return by Calendar Month ---
xy_bars(
    title='Which Months Favor Bulls or Bears?',
    category='3. Seasonality',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    y_axis_label='Avg Monthly Return',
    x_axis_label='Month',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='0%')
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Avg Monthly Return', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=4
)(values=monthly_ret, label=month_label)

# --- Heatmap: Year × Month Returns ---
heatmap(
    title='Monthly Returns: Every Data Point (Year × Month)',
    category='3. Seasonality',
    x_axis_label='Month',
    y_axis_label='Year',
    min_color=Color.Red,
    max_color=Color.Green,
    show_data_labels=True,
    data_label_format='{point.value:.1f}%',
    value_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    order=5
)(x=month_label, y=year_label, value=monthly_ret)

# =============================================================================
# CROSS-SECTIONAL SUMMARY: KEY STATS
# =============================================================================

# Annualized volatility (latest value from rolling 60d)
ann_vol = vol_60d

# YTD return: cumulative return since year start
year_start = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.year, boundary=BoundaryType.start)(idx)
ytd_cum = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Product)(1 + daily_ret, year_start) - 1

# Average Q2 return (April=4, May=5, June=6)
is_q2_month = (month_label > 3.5) and (month_label < 6.5)
q2_monthly_ret = monthly_ret if is_q2_month else 0.0 / 0.0

# Average Q2 return (expanding mean of Q2 monthly returns)
avg_q2_ret = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(q2_monthly_ret)

# Best and worst single monthly returns
best_month_ret = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Max)(monthly_ret)
worst_month_ret = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Min)(monthly_ret)

cs_summary_table(
    title='Key Statistics: WTI Crude Oil vs Natural Gas',
    category='4. Key Stats',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='Key Statistics',
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Ann. Volatility (60d)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='YTD Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Q2 Monthly Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Best Month', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Worst Month', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    order=6
)(ann_vol, ytd_cum, avg_q2_ret, best_month_ret, worst_month_ret)
